summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release reporting financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The company declared a cash dividend of $0.01 per common share payable on June 18, 2026 to shareholders of record June 10, 2026. Net income was $29.1 million ($0.25 EPS) versus $3.0 million ($0.01 EPS) in the prior year quarter. This is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No M&A, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report with no corporate action beyond ordinary dividend.
